# PRIMEPIPFX Trading Command Center

> A single trading application by founder Wahab Zafar: which currency pair to trade, fundamental data, backtesting tools, unlimited charts, premium TradingView, a freehand canvas, the Prime Pip SBT Indicator, community and a Psychological Command Center.

## Pages

- [Home / terminal](https://primepipfx.site/): sign in or create an account to use the terminal
- [About the founder and features](https://primepipfx.site/about.html): the full story of Wahab Zafar and everything the app offers
